mechanism: Ethambutol can cause hyperuricemia and may impair vitamin D metabolism; cholecalciferol supplementation may increase serum calcium and phosphate levels, potentially exacerbating ethambutol-induced hyperuricemia and gout risk.
action: Monitor serum calcium, phosphate, and uric acid levels during concurrent use; adjust cholecalciferol dosing based on vitamin D status and renal function; counsel patient on gout symptom awareness.
